records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails [email:843d28a4, email:b7add34c]. Welcome call was held [calendar:af7a2918], showing some intent, but no product action followed it, so unaided activation in 8 days looks unlikely though not negligible.

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks again for making time for our welcome call last week. I wanted to follow up while things are fresh.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting a first one in place is usually the easiest starting point. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready to bring the team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through that first project with you.

Best,
Priya
